violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at this visit.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS will conduct a follow up visit to ensure that a CFM is present.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Containers observed washed with old labels on.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS discussed removing labels before cleaning and reusing containers.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS under the ICE CREAM FLAT TOPS is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Please clean floors under units of ice cream base and debris.

No CFM present during this visit, employee present stated they are awaiting to take the CFM exam.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: Matcha milk cap observed dated 7/30/25.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution was measured at 500+ppm in a spray bottle container. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. EHS made sanitizer solution with employee to verify proper concentration and solution making process.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution at 150-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Spray bottle of sanitizer solution observed unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS will follow up to ensure bottles are labeled.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EHS will follow up with establishment to ensure a food thermometer has been obtained.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces for drizzle, dry powder toppings
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS will follow up with establishment to ensure containers are labeled.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Interior of 2 Dr prep with ice cream bases observed with ice cream drips and topping debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
